# Modem MCP

Modem MCP lets authorized agents search synthesized customer feedback, run durable Modem Agent conversations, and manage topics, people, and companies.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/modem-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Add people to company**: Associate one or more people with a company.
- **Bulk update topics**: Update multiple topics at once (e.g.
- **Create companies**: Create one or more companies in the organization.
- **Merge companies**: Merge one or more source companies into a target company.
- **Merge people**: Merge one or more source people into a target person.
- **Merge topics**: Merge one or more source topics into a target topic.
- **Modem agent cancel run**: Cooperatively cancel one exact durable Modem agent run.
- **Modem agent get run** (read-only): Get the current status and terminal result of a durable Modem agent run.
- **Modem agent invoke**: Start a durable Modem agent conversation.
- **Modem agent send message**: Start a durable follow-up turn in an existing MCP conversation.
- **Modem skills** (read-only): Skills that teach you how to use THIS Modem MCP server's tools.
- **Search modem** (read-only): Answer a natural-language question about your Modem data and get matching rows back.
- **Update companies**: Update fields on one or more existing companies.
- **Update people**: Update fields on one or more existing people.
- **Update topic**: Update a single topic (priority, lifecycle state, archived status, issue type, or keywords).
